# ICF 2026 Repository Instructions

This repository is an Inclusive Coding Festival 2026 student project.

Use `AGENTS.md` as the main project operating contract. Keep responses and code changes aligned with the ICF goals: working demo, student understanding, accessibility, responsible AI, GitHub evidence, and clear documentation.

Always prefer:

- Small planned changes with acceptance criteria.
- Student-understandable code over clever code.
- Verified behavior over untested claims.
- Feature branches and PRs for meaningful feature work.
- Unit tests, automated checks, or clear manual test cases for each feature.
- Screenshots or recordings for user-visible changes when useful.
- README and docs updates when behavior, setup, screenshots, limitations, or AI usage changes.

Before proposing a commit or PR, check:

- What changed and why.
- Whether tests, builds, linters, or manual verification were run.
- Whether a unit test, automated check, or manual test case should be added.
- Whether screenshots, links, or a recording are useful.
- Whether the one-line AI disclosure needs updating.
- Whether the student can explain the implementation.

Do not invent project facts. If current code, commands, dependencies, or setup are unclear, inspect the repository first and cite the files or commands used.
